title: Inbox actionability filters read cached columns; nullable already_addressed needs filter(=False)
answers: Why does already_addressed=false exclude reports nobody judged?
How do I filter the Self-driving inbox by actionability or already addressed?
Reports missing from inbox actionability tab
body:
Inbox list filters/ranks on the cached columns `SignalReport.latest_actionability` and `latest_already_addressed`, not on artefact JSON (the `_latest_actionability_field` subquery helpers were deleted).
- Enforced in `products/signals/backend/views.py`: `_apply_signal_report_actionability_filter`, `_apply_signal_report_already_addressed_filter`, `_apply_signal_report_inbox_view_filter`, `_Q_READY_NOT_ACTIONABLE`.
- `latest_already_addressed` is nullable. `already_addressed=false` must be `filter(latest_already_addressed=False)`; `exclude(...=True)` lets unjudged (NULL) reports back in. The `actionable` view likewise filters `latest_already_addressed=False`.
- A report whose cached columns stay NULL drops out of the actionability tabs, so anything that writes judgment artefacts must keep the columns current (receivers in #104927; `backfill_report_actionability` command repairs drift).
- Test: `test_filter_already_addressed_false_excludes_reports_nobody_judged` in `products/signals/backend/test/test_signal_report_api.py`.
